title: Pinball Machine with Bumpers and Flippers
prompt:
Create a single-HTML-file Three.js application simulating a 3D pinball machine with realistic ball physics, bumpers, flippers, and scoring.

【Three.js Import (must follow exactly)】
Place in <head>:
<script type="importmap">
{ "imports": {
    "three": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js",
    "three/addons/": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/"
} }
</script>
Then in <script type="module">:
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';

【Scene Setup】
- Background: dark (#111122)
- Camera: perspective, starting at (0, 25, 15) looking at (0, 5, 0)
- Lights: multiple colored point lights inside the machine for arcade ambiance (neon pink, blue, green), plus ambient light
- OrbitControls with damping, limited vertical rotation to prevent seeing under the table

【Playfield Construction】
The pinball table is a tilted rectangular surface:
- Dimensions: 10 units wide (x: -5 to +5), 20 units long (z: -10 to +10)
- Tilt: rotated 6 degrees around the x-axis (top end higher than bottom), so balls roll toward the player (toward +z)
- Surface: use lavatile.jpg as the table texture (loaded via TextureLoader, set repeat wrapping)
- Raised side walls (left, right, top): box geometry, height 0.5 units, metallic material
- Bottom opening: gap at z=+10 where balls can drain (no wall)

【Ball Physics (2D on tilted plane)】
Ball is a shiny metallic sphere (radius 0.3, chrome-like material):
- Physics runs in 2D on the tilted plane surface (x, z coordinates, with gravity component along the tilt)
- Gravity component along tilt: g_eff = 9.81 * sin(tiltAngle) acting in +z direction
- Ball velocity updated each frame: vz += g_eff * dt
- Wall collisions: elastic reflection with restitution 0.8
- Friction: velocity *= 0.998 per step (slight rolling friction)
- Integration: semi-implicit Euler, dt=0.016s (tied to frame rate with substeps if needed)

【Bumpers (5 circular bumpers)】
Place 5 circular bumpers at fixed positions on the upper half of the table:
- Bumper positions: (-2, 0.3, -5), (2, 0.3, -5), (0, 0.3, -3), (-3, 0.3, -7), (3, 0.3, -7)
- Each bumper: cylinder geometry (radius 0.6, height 0.6), glowing emissive material
- Collision detection: distance from ball center to bumper center < ball_radius + bumper_radius
- On collision: reflect ball velocity away from bumper center, multiply speed by 1.5 (spring bounce amplification)
- Bumper flashes brightly on hit (increase emissive intensity for 0.2s)
- Each bumper hit: +100 points

【Flippers (2 flippers)】
Two flippers at the bottom of the playfield:
- Left flipper: pivot at (-2, 0.2, 8), resting angle = -30 degrees, activated angle = +30 degrees
- Right flipper: pivot at (+2, 0.2, 8), resting angle = +30 degrees (mirrored), activated angle = -30 degrees (mirrored)
- Each flipper: elongated box (length 2.5, width 0.4, height 0.3)
- Flipper rotation: smooth interpolation (lerp) between rest and active angle, speed = 15 rad/s
- Controls: Left Shift activates left flipper, Right Shift activates right flipper
- On key release, flipper returns to rest position with gravity-assist (faster fall)
- Ball-flipper collision: treat flipper as a moving line segment; if ball overlaps, push ball away and add flipper angular velocity contribution to ball velocity

【Ball Launcher】
- Launch zone at bottom-right: a narrow channel at x=4.5, z from 8 to 10
- Press and hold 'Space' to charge the launcher (power increases over 1 second, shown as a power bar)
- Release 'Space' to launch: ball gets initial velocity in -z direction proportional to charge (range: 5 to 20 m/s)
- Power bar: thin colored bar (id='power-bar') that fills from green to red as you hold Space

【Multi-ball】
Press 'M' to launch an additional ball from the launcher with random power. Maximum 3 balls active simultaneously. Each ball is independent with its own physics.

【Drain and Lives】
- Ball drains when z > 10 (past the bottom edge)
- Player starts with 3 lives (balls)
- When all current balls drain, lose a life and auto-launch a new ball
- Game over when lives = 0
- Press 'N' for new game (reset score, lives, re-launch ball)

【Scoring】
- Bumper hit: +100 points
- Flipper save (ball hits flipper when moving toward drain): +10 points
- Combo: consecutive bumper hits within 2 seconds multiply score (x2, x3, x4, max x5)
- Score display: large text at top of screen

【Controls Summary】
(1) Left Shift: left flipper
(2) Right Shift: right flipper
(3) Space (hold/release): charge and launch ball
(4) 'M': add extra ball (multi-ball, max 3)
(5) 'N': new game
(6) Tilt slider (id='slider-tilt'): range 3 to 12, step 0.5, default 6 (degrees of table tilt)

【HUD (id='hud')】
Semi-transparent panel at top-left:
- id='hud-score': Current score
- id='hud-lives': Remaining lives
- id='hud-balls': Number of active balls
- id='hud-combo': Current combo multiplier
- id='hud-high-score': Session high score
- id='hud-tilt': Table tilt angle

【State Management】
Update window.__3D_STATE__ every frame:
{
  frameCount: number,
  score: number,                // current score
  lives: number,                // remaining lives (0-3)
  activeBalls: number,          // number of balls currently on table
  comboMultiplier: number,      // current combo (1-5)
  highScore: number,            // session high score
  tiltAngle: number,            // table tilt in degrees
  ballPositions: [{x, z}],     // array of active ball positions (2D on table)
  leftFlipperAngle: number,    // current left flipper angle in degrees
  rightFlipperAngle: number,   // current right flipper angle in degrees
  launchPower: number,          // current launch charge (0-1)
  gameOver: boolean,
  isPaused: boolean,
  simTime: number
}

【Physics Constraints】
- Ball must roll toward player due to table tilt (positive z drift when at rest)
- Bumper collisions must amplify speed (ball exits faster than it entered)
- Flippers must be able to send ball back up the table
- Ball cannot pass through walls or bumpers
- Multi-ball: each ball independent, balls do not collide with each other

Output a single HTML file.
physics_constraints: 2D ball physics on tilted plane. Gravity component along tilt g_eff = g*sin(tilt). Elastic wall collisions (restitution 0.8). Bumper spring bounce (1.5x speed multiplier). Flipper collision with angular velocity contribution. Ball-bumper circle collision detection. Launch velocity proportional to charge time. Maximum 3 simultaneous balls.
difficulty_analysis: L5: (1) 2D physics on tilted 3D plane requires coordinate transforms; (2) Multiple collision types: circle-circle (bumpers), circle-line (flippers/walls), circle-boundary (drain); (3) Flipper rotation with angular velocity contribution to ball; (4) Multi-ball with independent physics per ball; (5) Combo scoring system with timing; (6) Launch charge mechanic with hold/release; (7) Game state machine (playing, game over, new game); (8) Visual effects (bumper flash, neon lights).
